datasets.title: Panorama of Spiral Galaxy, M31
datasets.description: The Local Group Survey's panorama of M31 from the Mayall 4-meter telescope (U, B, V, I and H-alpha), with the DSS2 view filling its gaps and the outer disc. Milky Way foreground stars and the companions M32 and NGC 205 are removed, and the whole-galaxy colour is tied to RC3's measured B-V of 0.92. The bulge is spread through a round volume from a published bulge-plus-disc fit and the disc through a 342 pc layer; depth is modelled, not measured per pixel.
datasets.summary: Visible-light survey image on an approximate depth model with a round bulge; individual depths are not measured.
